Abstract, pp. 48–49: seventeen episcopal supporters, donations and Gregory’s portrayal of Chilperic and Fredegund.
VI.46 and VII.4–5, 7: Chilperic’s death in 584, Paris, sanctuary under Ragnemod, the golden dish, messengers to Guntram and the infant Chlothar.

note.de: Nach Chilperichs Tod nimmt Ragnemod die Königin in seiner Bischofskirche auf. Von Paris aus lässt sie Guntram um Beistand bitten.
note.en: After Chilperic’s death Ragnemod receives the queen at his cathedral. From Paris she sends to Guntram for support.
